@@ manual: KirstenAli/DeepJ DeepJPrism (Java) vs deepseek_v2 / llama @@
+embed (no scale, no positions) -> n_layers x [x + MLA(RMSNorm(x)); x + SwiGLU(RMSNorm(x))] -> RMSNorm -> Linear(d, vocab, bias=True), untied   (DeepJPrism.java:31-49, AbstractTransformerBlock.java:20-53)
+RMSNorm eps 1e-6 hard-coded (RMSNorm1D.java:11)
+MLA: q = (x Wdq) Wuq; c = x Wdkv; k = c Wuk; v = c Wuv; no latent norms, no decoupled RoPE head; RoPE (base 10000, interleaved pairs) over the whole head; scale 1/sqrt(head_dim)   (MultiHeadLatentAttention.java)
+SwiGLU with biased gate / up / down projections (DeepJPrismTransformerBlock.java, SwiGLULayer.java:30-42)
